text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOOOO!!!! I can't remember the title of 
that book at all!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a story with a super crybaby girl and 
a puppy, but... Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's not really enough to go on... Rob 
Roy, does that ring a bell?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, well... "The Lantern of a Snowy 
Night" or "The Big City and the Little 
Girl"... There are a few other books that 
might fit that description...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there was any snow~? They 
were running around in a flower field. I 
read it like crazy when I was little, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh well! Let's pray I remember it someday!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me!! I-I'll... go search for 
that book!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: WHAT?! Rob Roy?!

On my day off, while looking for work 
materials at a shopping mall bookstore—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you're a Trainer from the academy. I 
apologize, I was so focused on the 
bookshelves...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a book featuring a young girl and a 
puppy... Though for now, that's all the 
information I have.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It might have only been published 
overseas, so I checked the import corner 
as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is the last large bookstore around. 
If so, I'll believe in the slim chances 
and check used book stores and small shops 
too...!

Her disappointment was only momentary; 
Zenno Rob Roy immediately rallied her 
spirits. She seemed desperately keen on 
finding that book.
choice_data_list: Is it that important of a book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... yes. Though rather than for me, it's 
an important book to Taiki-san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I believe the books we read in childhood 
are truly special.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've always been shy and withdrawn ever 
since I was little. But there was a 
starting book that broadened my entire 
world.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that vast world, everyone lived their 
lives to the absolute fullest... As I read 
on, before I knew it, I wanted to take a 
step out into the world myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The starting book that saved me. Even as I 
grew up and read countless books, that 
special place in my heart has never 
changed...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, if Taiki-san wishes to read that 
memorable book once more, I want to 
fulfill that wish.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I thought doing so would be my way of 
giving back to books!
choice_data_list:
If that's the case, let me give you a 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, thank you! Checking each book 
one by one takes so much time, so that 
would be a huge help!

And so, we visited as many bookstores as 
we could—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... what do you think...! A crybaby 
girl, a small dog, and a flower field... 
this is the only one that matched.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thanks! But Rob Roy, unfortunately 
this isn't the book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I thought so, after all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As you read further in this book, the 
puppy turns into a dragon and they have 
dogfights in airships, which seem far more 
memorable...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, how did you even manage to find 
such a wild book...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Taiki-san, I'm so sorry I couldn't 
find it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Rob Roy! Thank you very, very 
much for searching for my sake!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My mom might remember the book of 
memories. If I find any hints, please help 
me search again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I'm super curious about 
this book now! Since we have it, mind if I 
read it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: O-Of course!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Rob Roy, let's read it together! 
I'm so thrilled for a story I've never 
heard before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm kind of curious about it too... 
Could I borrow that book after you're 
done?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Let's all read it together!

Though it wasn't the book we were looking 
for, I had a feeling this volume would 
become a cherished memory for the three of 
them.
